outline.rationale: The user is a strong SWE with little ML and no PM, prepping specifically for AIPM interviews. I skip software fundamentals and from-scratch ML math entirely. Two foundational gaps drive the early nodes: ML literacy (framed for reasoning, not deriving) and core PM craft (since they have zero PM). I add data/evaluation/tradeoffs and AI limitations as distinct ML-adjacent nodes because these are heavily probed in AIPM interviews and are MECE-separable from raw ML concepts. AI product strategy bridges PM and AI. The final three nodes are interview-format-specific (product design, technical/ML, behavioral/story) because the confirmed target is interview readiness, not on-the-job mastery — and the story node leverages their SWE background as positioning. Nine nodes is justified by two genuinely separate skill gaps plus interview-format coverage; each paragraph would have low overlap.
